prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, over-the-shoulder shot of a person intently working at a dual-monitor computer setup, with both screens displaying lines of code in a dark-themed text editor. The subject is partially out of focus in the foreground, their back and head silhouetted, drawing attention to the sharp, detailed code on the monitors. The lighting is soft and natural, likely from a window behind the screens, creating a calm, focused atmosphere. The color palette is dominated by the deep blacks and subtle grays of the monitors, punctuated by the colorful syntax highlighting of the code—vivid oranges, blues, greens, and whites. In the background, a hint of a green plant adds a touch of organic contrast to the otherwise technological scene. The composition emphasizes concentration and immersion in programming, with a shallow depth of field that blurs the subject while keeping the code crisp and readable, evoking a modern, cinematic workspace aesthetic.
